servicesHero.subhead: B-Trac Engineering Ltd. delivers five core engineering service divisions — spanning power systems, renewable energy, MEP, industrial water treatment, and nationwide after-sales support.

serviceList.heading: Five Service Divisions
serviceList.intro: Each division is staffed by factory-trained engineers and backed by BTEL's ISO 9001:2015 quality management system.

services.title: Substation & Switchgear Systems
services.description: Full-scope substation EPC from 11kV to 132kV — protection relays, SCADA, switchgear, and power transformers.

services.title: Solar Power Solutions
services.description: Turnkey solar EPC — rooftop, ground-mounted, and hybrid systems for industrial and commercial clients.

services.title: MEP / EPC Solutions
services.description: Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing engineering for factories, commercial buildings, data centres, and power plants.

services.title: Water Treatment Chemicals
services.description: Authorized distributor of NALCO (Ecolab) water treatment chemicals — boiler, cooling tower, RO, and engine coolant programs.

services.title: After Sales Support & Service
services.description: Nationwide, round-the-clock after-sales support — AMC contracts, spare parts supply, and emergency response across all delivered projects.

categories.name: Switchgear & Control Panels
categories.description: Turnkey electrical infrastructure — from 11kV substations and power transformers through switchgear, automation, and power quality.

products.title: 33kV & 11kV Substation System
products.writeUp: Complete turnkey substation solutions for 33kV systems, including design, engineering, supply, installation, testing, commissioning and maintenance ranging from 3MVA to 20MVA.

products.title: 11kV Substation System
products.writeUp: Complete turnkey substation solutions for 11kV systems, including design, engineering, supply, installation, testing, commissioning and maintenance ranging from 100kVA to 4000kVA.

products.title: Oil Type Transformer
products.writeUp: High-efficiency oil immersed transformers for reliable power transformation in industrial and utility applications for upto 20MVA.

products.title: High Voltage Switchgears
products.writeUp: Safe and dependable HV switchgear systems for power protection, switching, and network control.

products.title: Low Voltage Switchgears
products.writeUp: Custom LV switchgears designed for reliable power distribution, protection, and operational safety for upto 12,000 Amps.

products.title: AIS and GIS Panels
products.writeUp: Reliable air-insulated and gas-insulated switchgear solutions for modern substations.

products.title: Synchronization Panels
products.writeUp: State of the art synchronization panels for seamless generator and grid power management.

products.title: Automatic Transfer Switch
products.writeUp: Automatic power source transfer systems ensuring uninterrupted electrical supply upto 4000 Amps.

products.title: Automatic Voltage Regulators
products.writeUp: Automatic voltage regulation systems ensuring stable and reliable power output for 11kV and 33kV systems.

products.title: Motor Control Centres (MCC)
products.writeUp: Crafted motor control panels providing efficient operation, protection, and monitoring of industrial motors.

products.title: NGR-NGS Panels
products.writeUp: NGR-NGS panels designed to improve electrical safety and fault protection.

products.title: Industrial Power Distribution Systems
products.writeUp: Complete power distribution infrastructure engineered for industrial facilities.

products.title: Industrial UPS
products.writeUp: Reliable industrial UPS systems delivering continuous power for critical equipment ranging from 10kVA to 1200kVA.

products.title: Industrial Voltage Stabilizers
products.writeUp: Precision voltage stabilization solutions protecting equipment from voltage fluctuations.

products.title: Active / Passive Harmonic Filters
products.writeUp: Power quality solutions that reduce harmonics and improve system efficiency, filters range from 30kW to 600kW.

products.title: Lightning Protection Systems (LPS)
products.writeUp: Comprehensive lightning protection systems safeguarding facilities and equipment.

products.title: SCADA Automation Systems
products.writeUp: Advanced SCADA solutions for real-time monitoring, control, and remote operation of electrical assets.

products.title: Programmable Logic Controlling
products.writeUp: PLC-based automation systems for intelligent industrial process control. Featuring GE and WAGO.

products.title: Generator Controllers
products.writeUp: DEIF generator controllers for land-based prime power applications.

products.title: Marine Generator Controllers
products.writeUp: DEIF marine-grade generator control for marine power management systems.

products.title: Battery Chargers
products.writeUp: DEIF battery charging solutions for standby and emergency power systems.

products.title: Retrofitting Works of Existing Systems
products.writeUp: Modernization and upgrade services to improve the performance and reliability of existing electrical systems.

products.title: Testing Facility
products.writeUp: Comprehensive testing and quality assurance services to ensure compliance with industry standards.

products.title: Heavy Lifting & Logistics Support

products.title: Fire Hazard Management
